data.name: Basrat
data.gender_notes: Basrat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that means good news, glad tidings, or happiness. It is a name that is full of hope and optimism. The name Basrat carries the meaning “Good news, happiness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Basrat usually hope their child will grow to embody good news, happiness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the hope and optimism that comes from faith in God.
data.etymology: Basrat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good news, happiness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Basrat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Basrat
in_english.meaning: Source of insight and understanding, guiding individuals to make wise decisions
in_english.long_meaning: Basrat is a term that refers to the source of insight and understanding, which guides individuals to make wise decisions. Insight is a crucial aspect of human life, and it plays a significant role in helping individuals make informed decisions. In Islamic tradition, Basrat is considered an essential quality that enables individuals to distinguish between right and wrong, and to make choices that align with their values and principles. It is associated with the ability to discern truth from falsehood, and to make decisions that are guided by wisdom and discernment. The term Basrat is derived from the Arabic root "basr," which means "to discern" or "to see." In Islamic context, Basrat is often used to describe the ability to see beyond the surface level and to perceive the deeper meaning and reality of things.
